channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily curated opinion and blog posts from tech researchers and thinkers

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Quickly, There’s No Time
item.description: After the METR report, the AI Futures Project and Paul Christiano have sharply shortened their timelines — superintelligence automating AI R&D in 2027 is now a serious possibility, and Christiano sees takeover risk within 6–12 months.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: Enshittifiers groom us for scammers
item.description: Banks, insurers and governments have trained us to expect chaotic, ever-changing security rituals — the perfect cover for AI-powered fraud, since a scammer’s demands now look no weirder than the real thing.

item.title: Daniel Stenberg: Actual curl rewrites in Rust
item.description: AI agents rewrote curl’s 185k lines of C into Rust in three weeks — meanwhile the human maintainers merged 300+ commits and 200 bugfixes the rewrites don’t have; writing code once was never the hard part.

item.title: Gary Marcus: Wake up! America’s infrastructure is melting. And AI appears to be partly responsible.
item.description: A week of FAA ground stops, Outlook outages and a massive supply-chain cyberattack — Marcus blames vibe-coded software, unconstrained agents, and attackers exploiting AI faster than defenders.
